The function intended to prevent overflow with an incorrect 'add' function, allowing attackers to exploit the overflow to increase the attackPower of a champ, which can lead to the acquisition of rare items.

The function fails to ensure the total pointsToShare is correct, allowing attackers to exploit the incorrect probability to increase the attackPower of a champ, which can lead to the acquisition of rare items.
